description: Recommends optimal study patterns and techniques based on learning style and behavior

study_patterns.name: Pomodoro Technique
study_patterns.duration: 25 min study + 5 min break, 4 cycles then 15 min break
study_patterns.description: Short focused bursts followed by breaks. Keeps attention sharp and prevents burnout.
study_patterns.how_to: Set a timer for 25 minutes. Focus on one task only. Take a 5-minute break. After 4 rounds, take a 15-minute break.

study_patterns.name: Spaced Repetition
study_patterns.duration: Review at increasing intervals: 1 day, 3 days, 7 days, 14 days
study_patterns.description: Review material at gradually increasing intervals to strengthen long-term memory.
study_patterns.how_to: After learning new material, review it the next day, then 3 days later, then weekly. Use flashcards or summaries.

study_patterns.name: Active Recall
study_patterns.description: Test yourself on material instead of re-reading. Forces your brain to retrieve information actively.
study_patterns.how_to: Close your notes. Write down everything you remember about a topic. Check what you missed. Repeat.

study_patterns.name: Feynman Technique
study_patterns.description: Explain a concept in simple terms as if teaching someone else. Reveals gaps in your understanding.
study_patterns.how_to: Choose a concept. Explain it simply on paper. Identify gaps. Go back to source material. Simplify again.

study_patterns.name: Time Blocking
study_patterns.description: Assign specific time blocks to specific subjects. Prevents multitasking and ensures all courses get attention.
study_patterns.how_to: Create a weekly calendar. Assign each course a fixed time slot. Treat these blocks like classes you cannot skip.

study_patterns.name: Mind Mapping
study_patterns.description: Create visual diagrams connecting related concepts. Excellent for seeing the big picture.
study_patterns.how_to: Start with the main topic in the center. Branch out to subtopics. Add details and connections between branches.

study_patterns.name: Study Group Sessions
study_patterns.description: Collaborative study with peers. Each member teaches a topic to the group.
study_patterns.how_to: Form a group of 3-5 students. Each person prepares one topic. Take turns teaching. Discuss and ask questions.

study_patterns.name: Interleaving Practice
study_patterns.description: Switch between different subjects or problem types within a study session instead of focusing on one.
study_patterns.how_to: Study Subject A for 30 min, switch to Subject B for 30 min, then Subject C. This builds stronger connections.

light_load.pattern: 1 Pomodoro cycle per subject, 2 subjects per day

moderate_load.pattern: 2 Pomodoro cycles per subject, 2-3 subjects per day

heavy_load.pattern: Time blocking with 1.5hr blocks, 3-4 subjects per day

exam_period.pattern: Spaced repetition + Active recall focus, 2-3 subjects per day
